content:
Even though many new episodes of Ted Lasso Season 4 are yet to air, good news reported by Sigmund Judge suggests that fans won't have to wait too long after the season finale to see Season 5.

Apple is reportedly set to begin filming Ted Lasso Season 5 in January of next year.

When Ted Lasso Season 3 aired in 2023, it felt like the entire series had come to an end. Although many viewers (as well as the cast) wanted the show to continue, its future at the time remained uncertain.

Now Ted Lasso has finally made its return, and all signs indicate that Apple and Jason Sudeikis have already planned to film several more seasons.

A series of posts published by Judge on X today brings welcome news on this front.

Judge has previously accurately reported breaking news about Ted Lasso as well as other Apple TV related series.

With filming now scheduled to start in just a few months, there's a good chance we'll see Ted Lasso Season 5 return on Apple TV in 2027.

Season 4 will continue to air new episodes through October 7, so there's plenty of Lasso content to enjoy during this period. Although Apple has not officially announced a renewal, there's a good chance the Season 5 renewal news will be announced around the time Season 4 wraps up its run.

On a related note, another Apple series from Ted Lasso co-creator Bill Lawrence, Bad Monkey, will return later this year, while his other popular series Shrinking is also expected to air its fourth season in early 2027.

Are you already excited about the direction of Ted Lasso Season 5? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
